lane: Project status board plus mobile Package A leftovers (app-only)
goal: Give the Owner and every new agent one living status board (PLAN.md) and keep the 2026-10-30 review backlog in the repo instead of a temporary folder, add the Admin and multi-provider LLM proposals for Owner decision, and close the app-only Package A leftovers found in the 2026-11-03 audit: the Oracle launcher no longer repeats on Explore or covers the last row and reaches 48px, tab labels never collapse to icons only, persona and Council message actions reach 48px with a per-message report, Profile shows an invitation instead of 0/0/0 for a new account, and the Tarot spread hint shows only while the card is closed.
successCriteria: PLAN.md at the repository root lists the goal, Owner decisions, phase status, open work by area with IDs, Owner approvals waiting and the update rule; CLAUDE.md tells agents to read it first.
docs/backlog/review-2026-10-30.json holds all 107 review items with their status; PLAN.md summarizes counts and open items.

The Oracle launcher is not shown on Home, Explore, Chat, Tarot, Astrology or the Journal composer; where it shows, it is at least 48px tall and the scroll content has bottom padding so the last row is not covered.
While scrolling, the tab bar keeps its labels; it slides away only after a long scroll down and returns on scroll up or after 1.2 s idle.
Persona chat useful, not useful, save and a new report action, and the Council chat and report buttons, have at least 48 x 48 touch targets.
A new account sees an invitation on Tôi instead of three zero counters; counters return once any is above zero.
The spread hint Chạm để xem khi nào nên chọn kiểu này shows only while that spread card is closed.
Mobile type check and the full mobile Jest suite pass.

No Admin code change in this record.

Large-text caps, list virtualization, heading scale and remaining mixed-language labels are later slices tracked in PLAN.md.
